The prompt-completion hook observes the unchanged candidate bytes before the reconstruction workflow resumes. The test covers both newly created and seeded existing targets and checks the resulting receipt kind, path, preimage/postimage commitments and byte count, the ordered allowed/denied audit records, and successful publication/rebuild for the retained valid candidate.
